Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE finished, polished Portuguese-language landscape infographic, EXACT 16:9 aspect ratio, preferably 3840 x 2160 pixels. This is one of a coherent four-image presentation series for the actual game KANA RAIN.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the real game screenshot. Transform its art direction into an editorial game design infographic, do not copy its interface labels, numbers or layout.
Art direction: immersive hand-painted watercolor/gouache Japanese rain garden at blue hour, misty teal mountains, red maple leaves framing upper corners, mossy rocks and reflecting pond along bottom, warm amber stone lantern on far left, pavilion in the distant right. Deep midnight teal #082a30, desaturated jade, warm ivory #f7efd7, fine muted gold #c9ac71 outlines and bright gold #f5daa0 highlights. Restrained glowing aqua raindrops. Tiny rounded aqua rain spirit with two green leaves on its head, black eyes, small rosy cheeks, at bottom corner. Keep environmental painting clearly visible in margins, with dark near-opaque teal text panels.
Visual identity must closely match screenshot: elegant large classical serif titles, readable modern sans serif body text, fine gold chamfered frames, tiny leaf emblems, ample breathing room. Very high legibility and careful typography. Sophisticated illustrated editorial diagram, not a screenshot, no browser chrome, no generic corporate white background, no neon cyberpunk. Flat front-facing artwork. No watermark. No extra decorative text or invented information.
Use Portuguese copy exactly as supplied below, with accents intact. Headings and numerical values must be large, body text comfortable to read at full-screen slide size. Keep every panel, all typography, arrows and footer safely inside 4% margins. Do not invent other words.
SERIES IMAGE 01 / 04. Header, small brand: "KANA RAIN". Small upper-right gold badge: "01 / 04". Main title: "Arquitetura técnica". Subtitle: "HTML + CSS + JavaScript · Aplicação web sem framework em runtime".
Composition: central large chamfered panel for the game controller, surrounded by carefully aligned support panels. This is a dependency map, not a linear pipeline. Use elegant thin gold connectors, with clear arrow direction and no crossing through words.
Central panel exact text:
"INTERFACE E JOGO"
"game.js · index.html · style.css"
"Sessões, gotas, entrada, pontos e menus"
Place a small glowing kana drop あ within central panel.
Upper-left satellite, arrow INTO central:
"CATÁLOGO"
"data.js"
"208 kana · 60 palavras"
"Leituras e respostas aceitas"
Lower-left satellite, arrow INTO central:
"RITMO"
"difficulty.js · novelty.js"
"Vidas e velocidade por tempo ativo"
"Admissão gradual de novos kana"
Upper-right satellite, BIDIRECTIONAL connector with central:
"APRENDIZAGEM"
"learner.js"
"Tentativas, ajuda e familiaridade"
"Seleção de revisões e dificuldades"
Lower-right satellite, arrow FROM central:
"SOM"
"audio.js · sfx.js"
"Pronúncias gravadas"
"Efeitos de interface e jogo"
Below learning panel include separate slim attached storage panel with arrow FROM learning:
"PROGRESSO LOCAL"
"localStorage + IndexedDB"
"Histórico, preferências e exportação JSON"
Across bottom, distinct horizontal infrastructure rail, no arrow to storage:
"OFFLINE · Service Worker"
"Cache do aplicativo, imagens e áudios"
Footer: "Estado do código local · 13/10/2026".
